title: Levers for Increasing College Student Access to the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program: Evidence from Colorado
summary_en: In this report, the authors aim to provide federal, state, and local decisionmakers with evidence on four different options for expanding college student participation in the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program.
title_cn: Levers for Increasing College Student Access to the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program: Evidence from Colorado

title: College Students and the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program in Colorado: Key Findings for State Agencies, Colleges, and Counties
summary_en: This brief presents four key findings on Colorado college student participation in the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program and the barriers that college students face to participation.
title_cn: College Students and the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program in Colorado: Key Findings for State Agencies, Colleges, and Counties

title: What Colleges Can Do to Boost Student Participation in the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program: Lessons from Colorado
summary_en: This research brief provides an overview of how Colorado public postsecondary institutions have scaled application and case management support for the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program and the implications for student participation.
title_cn: What Colleges Can Do to Boost Student Participation in the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program: Lessons from Colorado

title: What States Can Do to Boost College Student Participation in the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program: Evidence from Colorado
summary_en: This brief describes two options that states can pursue to expand college student participation in the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program. Colorado data offer evidence on how these two actions might increase college student participation.
title_cn: What States Can Do to Boost College Student Participation in the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program: Evidence from Colorado
